title: Supply of 40 CNC vertical machining centres
description: Contoso Industrial Systems requires forty (40) 3-axis CNC vertical machining centres (minimum 1,000 x 500 mm table, 12,000 rpm spindle, 30-tool ATC) for the Rotterdam plant expansion, delivered DAP Rotterdam, installed and commissioned. Bids are evaluated in EUR.
